 Horoscopes Weekly Horoscope from October 25 to October 31: What to Expect for Your Sign
 The full moon in Taurus rises. Oct. 25, 2026, 12:40 PM EDT Lisa Stardust
 Share Add TODAY to Google Last week, Scorpio season began . This week, the full moon rises .
 The week of Oct. 25 through Oct. 31, Halloween, gives us the confidence to trust our gut logically. Astrology also helps us fantasize about the future and who we’d like to become, so don’t feel bad about getting caught up in a daydream; just make sure we find a way to turn those goals into action.
 The major astrological aspects are: 
 Oct. 25: Venus retrograde enters Libra, making us redefine partnerships.
 Oct. 26: The full moon in Taurus offers steady change to our lives. 
 Oct. 26: The sun in Scorpio activates Pluto in Aquarius, magnifying power struggles.
 Oct. 30: Venus retrograde in Libra links up with the True Node in Aquarius, radiating a destined sensation. 
 Oct. 30: Mercury retrograde in Scorpio squares Mars in Leo, intensifying our reactions.
 Read your weekly horoscope below: 
 Aries 
 This is a great time to break down emotional barriers and connect with someone special. If you’re not currently in a relationship, use this energy to spoil and appreciate yourself. These vibes also bode well for financial planning, so if you have a material dream you’ve been wanting to set in place, now’s the time. 
 Taurus 
 These vibes are great for reconnecting with your motivation, so chip away at any projects you’ve been meaning to start. A helpful connection to the True Node (or the nodes of destiny) will help you see the path ahead, but you’ll need to remember and learn from the mistakes of your past. 
 Gemini 
 Your psychic sensitivities will be heightened. Be mindful of who you surround yourself with, and try not to get sucked into any drama that doesn’t actually involve you. A dreamy, romantic ambiance will take hold. Passion projects will also take center stage later in the week, so re-envision your prospects.
 Cancer 
 Change isn’t in the stars right now; give yourself a few days, then try again once this resistant energy dissipates. Luckily, you’ll find that you are full of bright ideas. Be sure to write down any moments of brilliance your brain cooks up, so you can execute some serious manifestation later. 
 Leo
 You may also feel as though others are talking down to you right now or intentionally making your life difficult at the office, so you may be forced to push forward with your agenda despite these obstacles. This energy threatens to challenge what you usually feel, which can destabilize you and strain your emotions. 
 Virgo 
 You’ll avoid taking on new responsibilities or tasks to please people. A stressful connection between the Sun and Pluto will bring frustration, helping you shed any self-doubt or feelings of unworthiness you’ve been carrying lately by confronting issues and people that are causing the problem.
 Libra 
 If you need to vent throughout the week, hit up your bestie and let it all out. As the day ends, the vibe will stay serious but lighter. Use tonight to realign with your goals, and give yourself a little pep talk for the future. They will have your back and guide you forward with kind words and stellar advice. 
 Scorpio 
 If there’s any dead weight holding you back, you need to sever ties. The full moon allies with transformative Pluto, creating the perfect environment to push out the old so you can make way for the new. However, don’t let anyone talk you out of the changes you feel you need to make.
 Sagittarius 
 The cosmic climate is challenging and chaotic. The energy here can put your will and emotions at odds, making it hard to know which way to go. You may also feel weighed down and unmotivated as these funky sentiments wash over you, but you can calm your nerves with meditation.
 Capricorn 
 A celebratory vibe will settle on the collective and you, as your sun forms a soft, yet helpful aspect to the full moon. While most of this week was about having fun, this shift will inspire you to prepare for the work week ahead and take matters seriously instead of trying to keep your spirits high. 
 Aquarius 
 If any household chores fell to the wayside over the last couple of days, you should use this time to play catch-up. Don’t worry, though; you won’t have to spend the entire night catering to your responsibilities, thanks to the impact that the Hunter’s Moon puts upon you throughout the week.
 Pisces 
 While Mondays tend to be the most dreaded day of the week, recommitting to your work schedule won’t feel so difficult this time around, as the full moon forms an intense connection to the planet Pluto. Especially during the first part of the day, from the harsh square to the healing energy of the celestial entity. 
 Share Add TODAY to Google Lisa Stardust Lisa Stardust is a New York City-based astrologer. Stardust is the resident astrologer for Oprah Magazine, Teen Vogue and The Hoodwitch. She has two upcoming books: “Saturn Return Survival Guide: Navigating this cosmic rite of passage” is due out this May from Hardie Grant Books and “The Cosmic Deck” from Chronicle Books is due out in November.
